# TPC-DS-OBT Q80

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ssr AS (SELECT obt.store_s_store_id AS store_id, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(obt.return_amount, 0)) AS returns, SUM(obt.net_profit - COALESCE(obt.return_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.item_i_current_price > 50 AND obt.promo_sk = obt.promo_p_promo_sk AND obt.promo_p_channel_tv = 'N') AND (obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk AND obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id)) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.store_s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(obt.return_amount, 0)) AS returns, SUM(obt.net_profit - COALESCE(obt.return_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND obt.catalog_page_sk = obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.item_i_current_price > 50 AND obt.promo_sk = obt.promo_p_promo_sk AND obt.promo_p_channel_tv = 'N') AND (obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk AND obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id)) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY obt.catalog_page_cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT obt.web_site_web_site_id, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(COALESCE(obt.return_amount, 0)) AS returns, SUM(obt.net_profit - COALESCE(obt.return_net_loss, 0)) AS profit FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE ((obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.sold_date_d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) AND (CAST('1998-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') AND web_site_web_site_sk = obt.web_site_web_site_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.item_i_current_price > 50 AND obt.promo_sk = obt.promo_p_promo_sk AND obt.promo_p_channel_tv = 'N') AND (obt.item_sk = obt.item_sk AND obt.sale_id = obt.sale_id)) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY obt.web_site_web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel, id LIMIT 100
```
